reason: README documents a `nougat` CLI that runs the small 0.1.0-small model (~1GB download from GitHub releases, no auth) on a PDF, feasible on CPU for one page.
demo: README 'Get prediction for a PDF' > CLI: nougat path/to/file.pdf -o output_directory
goal: Install nougat-ocr from /work/nougat so the `nougat` command works on CPU (resolve any dependency version conflicts, e.g. transformers/albumentations/pypdfium2 pins). Then `nougat some.pdf -o outdir --no-skipping -p 1` must download the default 0.1.0-small checkpoint and write a non-empty .mmd file with the recognized text of a simple one-page PDF.
check: Runs the nougat CLI on a generated one-page text PDF and checks that a non-empty .mmd output file is produced containing recognizable words from the page.
